items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: No, it had Pete Clark, Wallace Bishop, Billy Kyle, Kirby, and who else....

ctx.x: drinkers a night... A great, big long bar, and they had about three customers a night in there drinking beer. And the man turned the place over to his two sons who had just come out of the Army. So the sons wanted to put music in the place, make it like a cabaret, put tables in there, it had this long bar and had the band behind the bar.

So they contacted Kirby, and Kirby had taken the band out to Milwaukee, and we opened up. Well, they had the band that I named before... No, it had Pete Clark, Wallace Bishop, Billy Kyle, Kirby, and who else....
